title: STNFS with both-bars alpha (5.15, 0.85), theta 19/50, slacks (294, 225), UDUP 0.6, per-side count radii: 121.32193

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the STNFS algorithm in proof.md and DESCENT.md with the REFINEMENT.md refinements, 99.9% ECM, X2 = 2^64, theta = 19/50 collection, the measured record route and the STORAGE.md/row_tail.c kernels returns Q satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P, with success at least 0.394319 (hence at least 0.39) under disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (H4u: at least 88% of filtered matrix row weight is +-1 entries). It computes two GT logarithms and returns Q=[a]Q0, handling z=1 directly. All classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^121.32193 dense-Fp12 units, C=20,000 instructions, upper-rounded ledger rows summing to <= 2^121.32193. Theta=19/50 (1040 rows, a-radius 892) with slacks (294, 225), allowance 1.0674, alpha (5.15, 0.85), primes in [2^63, 2^64) charged twice, records routed at 10.01 and re-read at 7.003: collection <= 2^121.1502 units. The work side uses per-side count radii (a-upper at 892, b-upper per qa quartile bin at floored b-rmin 1263/1212/1167/1140); yield keeps the global lower product, so margin, LA, descent and success are unchanged from the cited source. The 62-node descent plan (35 entries differ from base, boot unchanged) is evaluated at UDUP = 0.6 and THIN_MAX 85. Linear algebra (20.7 per sparse entry, 2,710 per row, 97 per dense term, 420 per 9-limb reduction, N = 1.096 x 0.0471 U, blocks (19, 4)) is <= 2^117.7103 units, generator <= 2^107.1997. Descent credits UDUP = 0.6 (23% below measured 0.779, 28% below the 200-point 0.8353), discards only up to 2^90, keeps 18 boot relations. Expected two-log work <= 2^115.5527; meter 2^116.28; Markov abort <= 0.6040334. Boot failure 4.800e-05 per log, expected nodes 2^17.26, node abort 2^-10.04, repeats 2^-10.70, 2/r charged. Preprocessing, failures, advice, transfers, verification and output included; nothing amortized. Certificate construction gets 2^50 units. Memory <= 2^105 bytes. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, and nonzero lower/upper integration controls. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) to mean weight 100 and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).
Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger, retention, ECM, descent and declared bounds (about 30 s natively; longer when emulated).
